svg.aria-label: Unsolved inverse rectangle: known direct diagonal thirteen metres, one perpendicular leg five metres, other side unknown. Compare direct and two-edge journeys with a fifteen metre limit. No missing side or winning route disclosed.
svg.title: Inverse missing-leg journey
svg.desc: Given diagonal thirteen metres, one side five metres and other side unknown. The learner must retrieve and invert the right-triangle relationship before the route decision.

g.text: Recover the leg and judge paths
